profile: Pacira BioSciences develops and markets non-opioid pain treatments. Its commercial products include EXPAREL, a long-acting local analgesic approved for postsurgical pain management; ZILRETTA, an extended-release injection indicated for osteoarthritis knee pain; and iovera, a handheld device that uses controlled cold to provide targeted, drug-free pain control. The company also develops gene therapy candidates for osteoarthritis.
